note: Field catalog for SKILL.md frontmatter. 'requirement' is hard (violations fail validation) or advisory (best practice).

fields.name: name
rules: lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens only
must not start or end with a hyphen
must equal the parent directory name

fields.name: description
rules: should state both what the skill does and when to use it
fields.example: Extract PDF text, fill forms, merge files. Use when handling PDFs.

fields.name: license
rules: keep it short: a license name or a bundled file reference

fields.name: compatibility
rules: only include when the skill has specific environment requirements

fields.name: metadata
rules: map of string keys to string values
